svg.title: How Instana finds the cause
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. Instana discovers your applications and infrastructure and maps their dependencies on its own. It updates full-stack data every second. With one click its agentic AI investigates an incident, names the probable root cause and drafts a runbook; a person chooses which steps run.
